008import io.avaje.jsonb.Jsonb;
009import java.io.IOException;
010import java.io.InputStream;
011import java.net.URL;
012import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
013import java.nio.file.Files;

023/**
024 * Class for representing a FIRST field, optional field image metadata, and optional tag poses.
025 *
026 * <p>The JSON format contains the top-level objects "name", "season", "game", "field-dimensions",
027 * and "program", and can optionally contain "field-image" and "field-tags". The "field-dimensions"
028 * object stores "length" and "width" in meters. The "field-image" object stores the image path and
029 * the field boundaries in image pixels. The "field-tags" object stores all field tags contained
030 * within a layout.
031 *
032 * <p>Pose3ds in the JSON use the field coordinate system: the origin is at field center on the
033 * floor, +X points toward the blue alliance wall, +Y points left when facing +X, and +Z points up.
034 * {@link #setOrigin(Pose3d)} changes the reference frame of poses returned by {@link
035 * #getTagPose(int)}.
036 *
037 * <p>Tag poses represent the center of the tag. A zero rotation represents an upright tag facing +X
038 * (toward the blue alliance wall). Positive yaw is counterclockwise viewed from above.
039 */
040@Json
041public final class Field {
042  /** Common origin positions for the field tag coordinate system. */
043  public enum OriginPosition {
044    /** Field center, with +X toward the blue alliance wall (the default). */
045    FIELD_CENTER,
046    /** Blue alliance wall, right side, facing into the field. */
047    BLUE_ALLIANCE_WALL_RIGHT_SIDE,
048    /** Red alliance wall, right side, facing into the field. */
049    RED_ALLIANCE_WALL_RIGHT_SIDE,
050  }
051
052  /** JSON representation of the physical field dimensions. */
053  @Json
054  static class FieldDimensions {
055    /** Field length in meters. */
056    @Json.Property("length")
057    public double length;
058
059    /** Field width in meters. */
060    @Json.Property("width")
061    public double width;
062
063    FieldDimensions() {}
064
065    FieldDimensions(double length, double width) {
066      this.length = length;
067      this.width = width;
068    }
069  }
070
071  /** Human-readable field name. */
072  @Json.Property("name")
073  public String name;
074
075  /** Field season. */
076  @Json.Property("season")
077  public String season;
078
079  /** Game name. */
080  @Json.Property("game")
081  public String game;
082
083  /** Field image metadata, or null if this field has no image. */
084  @Json.Property("field-image")
085  public FieldImage fieldImage;
086
087  /** Field length in meters. */
088  @Json.Ignore public double length;
089
090  /** Field width in meters. */
091  @Json.Ignore public double width;
092
093  /** FIRST program. */
094  @Json.Property("program")
095  public String program;
096
097  /** Field tag metadata, or null if this field has no tag layout. */
098  @Json.Property("field-tags")
099  public List<FieldTag> tags;
100
101  /** JSON resource path for this field, or null if this field was loaded from a file. */
102  @Json.Ignore public String resourceFile;
103
104  @Json.Ignore private Pose3d m_origin = Pose3d.ZERO;
105  @Json.Ignore private String m_json;
106  @Json.Ignore private Supplier<String> m_jsonSupplier;
107
108  /** Constructs an empty field object for JSON deserialization. */
109  public Field() {}
110
111  @Json.Creator
112  Field(
113      String name,
114      String season,
115      String game,
116      FieldImage fieldImage,
117      @Json.Alias("field-dimensions") FieldDimensions fieldDimensions,
118      String program,
119      List<FieldTag> tags) {
120    this(
121        name,
122        season,
123        game,
124        fieldImage,
125        requireFieldDimensions(fieldDimensions).length,
126        requireFieldDimensions(fieldDimensions).width,
127        program,
128        tags);
129  }
130
131  private static FieldDimensions requireFieldDimensions(FieldDimensions fieldDimensions) {
132    return Objects.requireNonNull(fieldDimensions, "field-dimensions");
133  }
134
135  private static FieldImage requireFieldImagePath(FieldImage fieldImage) {
136    if (fieldImage != null) {
137      Objects.requireNonNull(fieldImage.path, "field-image.path");
138    }
139    return fieldImage;
140  }
141
142  /**
143   * Constructs a field object.
144   *
145   * @param name Human-readable field name.
146   * @param season Field season.
147   * @param game Game name.
148   * @param fieldImage Field image metadata, or null if this field has no image.
149   * @param fieldLength Field length in meters.
150   * @param fieldWidth Field width in meters.
151   * @param program FIRST program.
152   * @param tags Field tag metadata, or null if this field has no tag layout.
153   */
154  public Field(
155      String name,
156      String season,
157      String game,
158      FieldImage fieldImage,
159      double fieldLength,
160      double fieldWidth,
161      String program,
162      List<FieldTag> tags) {
163    this(name, season, game, fieldImage, fieldLength, fieldWidth, program, null, tags, null);
164  }
165
166  Field(
167      String name,
168      String season,
169      String game,
170      FieldImage fieldImage,
171      double fieldLength,
172      double fieldWidth,
173      String program,
174      String resourceFile,
175      List<FieldTag> tags,
176      Supplier<String> jsonSupplier) {
177    this.name = name;
178    this.season = season;
179    this.game = game;
180    this.fieldImage = requireFieldImagePath(fieldImage);
181    this.length = fieldLength;
182    this.width = fieldWidth;
183    this.program = program;
184    this.resourceFile = resourceFile;
185    this.tags = tags == null ? null : List.copyOf(tags);
186    m_jsonSupplier = jsonSupplier;
187  }
188
189  Field(Field other) {
190    name = other.name;
191    season = other.season;
192    game = other.game;
193    fieldImage =
194        other.fieldImage == null
195            ? null
196            : new FieldImage(
197                other.fieldImage.path,
198                other.fieldImage.top,
199                other.fieldImage.left,
200                other.fieldImage.bottom,
201                other.fieldImage.right);
202    length = other.length;
203    width = other.width;
204    program = other.program;
205    tags = other.tags == null ? null : List.copyOf(other.tags);
206    resourceFile = other.resourceFile;
207    m_origin = other.m_origin;
208    m_json = other.m_json;
209    m_jsonSupplier = other.m_jsonSupplier;
210  }
211
212  /**
213   * Returns the human-readable field name.
214   *
215   * @return The human-readable field name.
216   */
217  public String getName() {
218    return name;
219  }
220
221  /**
222   * Returns true if this field has field image metadata.
223   *
224   * @return True if this field has field image metadata.
225   */
226  public boolean hasImage() {
227    return fieldImage != null;
228  }
229
230  /**
231   * Gets the resource path of the field image described by this field.
232   *
233   * @return The image resource path, or null if this field has no image.
234   */
235  public String getImageResource() {
236    if (fieldImage == null) {
237      return null;
238    }
239    if (fieldImage.path.startsWith("/")) {
240      return fieldImage.path;
241    }
242    if (resourceFile != null && resourceFile.startsWith("/")) {
243      return getResourceParent(resourceFile) + fieldImage.path;
244    }
245    return Fields.BASE_RESOURCE_DIR + getImageResourcePath();
246  }
247
248  /**
249   * Gets the URL of the field image described by this field.
250   *
251   * <p>This returns null unless this field has an image and the separate field image resources
252   * artifact is present on the runtime classpath.
253   *
254   * @return The image URL, or null if the image resource is not available.
255   */
256  public URL getImageUrl() {
257    String resourcePath = getImageResource();
258    if (resourcePath == null) {
259      return null;
260    }
261    return getClass().getResource(resourcePath);
262  }
263
264  /**
265   * Gets an input stream for the field image described by this field.
266   *
267   * <p>This returns null unless this field has an image and the separate field image resources
268   * artifact is present on the runtime classpath.
269   *
270   * @return The image input stream, or null if the image resource is not available.
271   */
272  public InputStream getImageAsStream() {
273    String resourcePath = getImageResource();
274    if (resourcePath == null) {
275      return null;
276    }
277    return getClass().getResourceAsStream(resourcePath);
278  }
279
280  private String getImageResourcePath() {
281    String prefix = program + "/";
282    return fieldImage.path.startsWith(prefix) ? fieldImage.path : prefix + fieldImage.path;
283  }
284
285  private static String getResourceParent(String resourcePath) {
286    int lastSeparator = resourcePath.lastIndexOf('/');
287    return lastSeparator < 0 ? "" : resourcePath.substring(0, lastSeparator + 1);
288  }
289
290  /**
291   * Returns the original JSON contents for this field.
292   *
293   * @return The original JSON contents for this field, or null if none were retained.
294   */
295  public String getJson() {
296    if (m_json != null) {
297      return m_json;
298    }
299    if (m_jsonSupplier == null) {
300      return null;
301    }
302    m_json = m_jsonSupplier.get();
303    return m_json;
304  }
305
306  /**
307   * Returns true if this field has tag metadata.
308   *
309   * @return True if this field has tag metadata.
310   */
311  public boolean hasTags() {
312    return tags != null;
313  }
314
315  /**
316   * Returns a List of the {@link FieldTag FieldTags} used by this field.
317   *
318   * @return The {@link FieldTag FieldTags} used by this field.
319   */
320  public List<FieldTag> getTags() {
321    return tags == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(tags);
322  }
323
324  /**
325   * Returns the field length in meters.
326   *
327   * @return The field length in meters.
328   */
329  public double getFieldLength() {
330    return length;
331  }
332
333  /**
334   * Returns the field width in meters.
335   *
336   * @return The field width in meters.
337   */
338  public double getFieldWidth() {
339    return width;
340  }
341
342  /**
343   * Sets the origin based on a predefined enumeration of coordinate frame origins. The origins are
344   * calculated from the field dimensions.
345   *
346   * <p>This transforms the Pose3d objects returned by {@link #getTagPose(int)} to return the
347   * correct pose relative to a predefined coordinate frame.
348   *
349   * @param origin The predefined origin.
350   */
351  public void setOrigin(OriginPosition origin) {
352    var pose =
353        switch (origin) {
354          case FIELD_CENTER -> Pose3d.ZERO;
355          case BLUE_ALLIANCE_WALL_RIGHT_SIDE ->
356              new Pose3d(
357                  new Translation3d(length / 2, width / 2, 0), new Rotation3d(0, 0, Math.PI));
358          case RED_ALLIANCE_WALL_RIGHT_SIDE ->
359              new Pose3d(new Translation3d(-length / 2, -width / 2, 0), Rotation3d.ZERO);
360        };
361    setOrigin(pose);
362  }
363
364  /**
365   * Sets the origin for tag pose transformation.
366   *
367   * <p>This transforms the Pose3d objects returned by {@link #getTagPose(int)} to return the
368   * correct pose relative to the provided origin.
369   *
370   * @param origin The new origin for tag transformations.
371   */
372  public void setOrigin(Pose3d origin) {
373    m_origin = origin;
374  }
375
376  /**
377   * Returns the origin used for tag pose transformation.
378   *
379   * @return The origin.
380   */
381  public Pose3d getOrigin() {
382    return m_origin;
383  }
384
385  /**
386   * Gets a tag pose by its ID.
387   *
388   * @param ID The ID of the tag.
389   * @return The pose corresponding to the ID passed in or an empty optional if a tag with that ID
390   *     was not found.
391   */
392  @SuppressWarnings("ParameterName")
393  public Optional<Pose3d> getTagPose(int ID) {
394    if (tags == null) {
395      return Optional.empty();
396    }
397    for (FieldTag tag : tags) {
398      if (tag.getID() == ID) {
399        return Optional.of(tag.getPose().relativeTo(m_origin));
400      }
401    }
402    return Optional.empty();
403  }

405  /**
406   * Serializes a field to a JSON file.
407   *
408   * @param path The path to write to.
409   * @throws IOException If writing to the file fails.
410   */
411  public void serialize(String path) throws IOException {
412    serialize(Path.of(path));
413  }
414
415  /**
416   * Serializes a field to a JSON file.
417   *
418   * @param path The path to write to.
419   * @throws IOException If writing to the file fails.
420   */
421  public void serialize(Path path) throws IOException {
422    Jsonb.instance().type(Field.class).toJson(this, Files.newBufferedWriter(path));
423  }
424
425  @Json.Property("field-dimensions")
426  FieldDimensions getFieldDimensions() {
427    return new FieldDimensions(length, width);
428  }

430  /**
431   * Loads a predefined field.
432   *
433   * @param field The predefined field.
434   * @return The field.
435   */
436  public static Field loadField(Fields field) {
437    return field.loadField();
438  }
439
440  /**
441   * Loads a field from a file on disk.
442   *
443   * @param file The JSON file to load.
444   * @return The field.
445   * @throws IOException Throws if the file could not be loaded.
446   */
447  public static Field loadFromFile(Path file) throws IOException {
448    return fromJson(Files.readString(file));
449  }
450
451  /**
452   * Loads a field from a resource file located inside the program's jar file.
453   *
454   * @param resourcePath The path to the resource file.
455   * @return The field.
456   * @throws IOException Throws if the resource could not be loaded.
457   */
458  public static Field loadFromResource(String resourcePath) throws IOException {
459    try (InputStream stream = Field.class.getResourceAsStream(resourcePath)) {
460      if (stream == null) {
461        throw new IOException("Could not locate resource: " + resourcePath);
462      }
463      Field field = fromJson(new String(stream.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
464      field.resourceFile = normalizeResourcePath(resourcePath);
465      return field;
466    }
467  }
468
469  private static String normalizeResourcePath(String resourcePath) {
470    if (resourcePath.startsWith("/")) {
471      return resourcePath;
472    }
473    return "/" + Field.class.getPackageName().replace('.', '/') + "/" + resourcePath;
474  }
475
476  Field copy() {
477    return new Field(this);
478  }
479
480  void setJson(String json) {
481    m_json = json;
482  }
483
484  private static Field fromJson(String json) {
485    Field field = Jsonb.instance().type(Field.class).fromJson(json);
486    field.setJson(json);
487    return field;
488  }
489
490  @Override
491  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
492    return obj instanceof Field other
493        && Objects.equals(getName(), other.getName())
494        && Objects.equals(season, other.season)
495        && Objects.equals(game, other.game)
496        && Objects.equals(fieldImage, other.fieldImage)
497        && length == other.length
498        && width == other.width
499        && Objects.equals(program, other.program)
500        && Objects.equals(tags, other.tags)
501        && Objects.equals(m_origin, other.m_origin);
502  }
503
504  @Override
505  public int hashCode() {
506    return Objects.hash(
507        getName(), season, game, fieldImage, length, width, program, tags, m_origin);
508  }
509}
